title: Weak-* convergence of all Jacobian minors of uniformly convergent, uniformly Lipschitz maps (the Claim of parent step 3)
statement: Let k, Q ∈ ℕ, let Ω ⊆ ℝ^k (ℝ^k = Eucl k) be open, C ≥ 0, and let v_j : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q (j ∈ ℕ) and v₀ : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q all be C-Lipschitz on Ω with v_j → v₀ uniformly on Ω. For r ∈ ℕ, a : Fin r → Fin Q, b : Fin r → Fin k and u : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q let M_{a,b}(u)(w) := det(EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ u w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1)))_{t,s ∈ Fin r} (the r×r Jacobian minor with rows a and columns b; Mathlib fderiv, 0 where u is not differentiable; the empty determinant is 1). Then for every r, every a, b and every η : ℝ^k → ℝ that is Lebesgue-integrable on Ω: ∫_Ω η(w)·M_{a,b}(v_j)(w) dw → ∫_Ω η(w)·M_{a,b}(v₀)(w) dw as j → ∞ (dw = Lebesgue measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (k Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (C : ℝ≥0) (v : ℕ → Eucl k → Eucl Q) (v₀ : Eucl k → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → (∀ j, LipschitzOnWith C (v j) Ω) → LipschitzOnWith C v₀ Ω → TendstoUniformlyOn v v₀ atTop Ω → ∀ (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → Fin Q) (b : Fin r → Fin k) (η : Eucl k → ℝ), IntegrableOn η Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, η w * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ (v j) w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, η w * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ v₀ w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
